[[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] traveled to [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]] in [[137 ABY]] aboard a''' ''Crix''-class diplomatic courier shuttle'''. The [[Crix-class diplomatic courier shuttle|shuttle]] was later [[Skirmish on The Wheel|fired upon]] by a [[Unidentified Nune-class Imperial shuttle|''Nune''-class Imperial shuttle]] of the [[Empire-in-exile]], whose controls had been [[Slicer/Legends|overridden]] by four [[Command Override Limpet Droid]]s planted by [[Agent/Legends|agents]] of the [[One Sith]] and [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]].
